theme_strategy: Light and Dark theme support. Default to Light Theme for an editorial, high-end boutique e-commerce feel (where products/clothes pop), with a sophisticated dark mode option.

headings.style: Elegant, high-contrast, editorial. Never use Inter for headings. Keep tracking tight (tracking-tighter) for large headings.

body.style: Clean, highly legible geometric sans for data (measurements) and UI elements. Loose line height (leading-relaxed) for body paragraphs.

rules: Never use pure #000000 or pure #808080. Always tint greys.
Ensure WCAG AA contrast for text.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use crisp, rectangular surfaces (cardless or sharp edges, max 4px radius) for the fashion editorial look.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or modal overlays, use backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px delicate inner border.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton for the dashboard/measurements area. Use 1px subtle borders to separate data points clearly.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use subtle ambient shadows or crisp 1px borders instead of heavy drop shadows.

components.strategy: Hybrid approach: pure HTML/Tailwind for creative landing/marketing sections, heavily customized Shadcn UI for the dashboard, forms, and uploads.
components.buttons: Sharp edges or very slight rounding. Use high-contrast solid fill for primary, delicate 1px border for secondary. Add subtle scale/translate on hover.
components.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn Form/Input components. Use generous padding. Inputs should have clear, minimalist borders.
components.upload_zone: Large, elegant drag-and-drop areas for photo and clothing uploads. Use dashed borders that turn solid on drag-over.
components.image_gallery: Masonry or Bento grid for the wardrobe and saved try-ons. Images must fill the container entirely using object-cover.
components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight) for a high-end, refined look.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped UIs.
grids_and_layouts.marketing_landing: Asymmetrical layouts. Use wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Overlapping elements for editorial tension.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_wardrobe: High-density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align forms, inputs, and dense content. Headings can be aligned to create visual tension.

motion.interactions: Smooth, refined micro-interactions. Hover states must change text color or background explicitly.
motion.transitions: Specific property transitions only (e.g., transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease). NO 'transition: all'.
motion.page_load: Subtle fade-in and slight upward translation (staggered) for wardrobe items and dashboard widgets.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. Validate all colors.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on inputs and buttons (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary_accent).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-photo-btn').

media.images: Images are the core of this app. Use max-h-[80vh] for mobile image previews to prevent excessive scrolling.
media.overlays: If text is over an image, use max bg-black/40 (or white/40 in light mode) for hero sections. Never obscure the fashion.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install Playfair Display and Manrope fonts. Install @phosphor-icons/react. Configure Tailwind to include these fonts and the custom color palette.
instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Build a hybrid app. The public landing page should be heavily styled and editorial. The authenticated app (Dashboard, Profile, Try-on Studio) should use robust Shadcn forms and precise layouts.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_flow: Mock the Google Auth flow and AI image generation (Gemini Nano Banana). Ensure the UI clearly shows the transition from 'upload' to 'generating' to 'result'.
instructions_to_main_agent.forms: The body measurement form should be elegant. Group measurements logically (e.g., Upper Body, Lower Body) so it doesn't overwhelm the user.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Avoid the standard 'Vercel look'. Make it look like a high-end fashion magazine.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.depth_and_layering: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.css_rules: Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.components: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Use sonner for toasts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use the specified icon library.
